summary: Media playback and streaming were made more reliable, including keeping live-stream duration unknown until a download ends and ensuring seeks and Opus audio decoding use consistent information. Video conversion now better preserves color, format, and rotation details across I420 and NV12, while audio-graph operations are resolved on the correct thread. The browser’s Feature Policy terminology was also updated to **Permissions Policy**, the standard name for rules that control which features a site can use.
